director_of_hardware_engineering.title: Director of Hardware Engineering
director_of_hardware_engineering.objective: Direct leadership over multi-disciplinary hardware teams containing 30–80 engineers; on-time delivery of hardware design milestones from concept to Design Validation Test (DVT); ensure full compliance with relevant safety standards (ISO 26262, UL 9540); manage engineering budget, prototyping expenses, and lab infrastructure.

staff_product_manager_platform.title: Staff Product Manager (Platform)
staff_product_manager_platform.objective: Functional ownership over core cross-BU platform software, telemetry APIs, and edge computing architectures; synthesize market requirements into detailed engineering epics and user stories; prioritize feature backlogs balancing enterprise platform stability with new BU-specific features; lead cross-functional alignment between engineering, legal, security, and commercial strategy.

principal_mlops_engineer.title: Principal MLOps Engineer
principal_mlops_engineer.objective: Technical leadership for enterprise-wide ML pipelines, battery analytics models, and predictive maintenance fleets; design, deploy, and maintain scalable infrastructure for training and inferencing ML models at the edge and in the cloud; establish CI/CD pipelines for continuous model retraining based on live vehicle/storage telemetry; drive data governance, model monitoring, and latency minimization across battery health analytics platforms.

senior_embedded_firmware_engineer.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
senior_embedded_firmware_engineer.objective: Direct ownership of low-level software modules operating on custom bare-metal and RTOS microcontrollers across energy systems; write clean, deterministic C/C++ code for motor control, BMS logic, or solar inverter microcontrollers; implement standard communication protocols (CAN, Modbus, Ethernet/IP) and hardware drivers; perform unit testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, and code reviews.
